summary: Caller interrupted with pricing questions; agent never returned to qualification or booking flow.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hi, this is Alex with Summit Home Services. I can help schedule a free HVAC inspection.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Before that—how much do repairs usually cost if you find something?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Repairs vary widely depending on parts and system age.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Okay I'm back. Also do you work on weekends?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Saturday appointments are limited but sometimes available.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Sure. What were you asking about again?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: You didn't ask if I'm a homeowner or get my address.
